scoring_justification: Checker recomputes Hall-Petch slopes from raw pileup data and compares the slope ratios against reference values derived from the paper's analytic formulas.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold slope ratio for Case II locked dislocation pileup
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from asymptotic formulas with Q=1.84 for m=1 and Q=5.1 for m=2, yielding ratio sqrt(5.1/1.84) ≈ 1.665; paper reports about 1.7.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Analytic evaluation of Hall-Petch slope from eq.11 and Q values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly computed from published parameters in the paper.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold slope ratio for Case I two-phase screw pileup
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from eq.20 with alpha=2, beta=pi-2, giving exact factor 2.0 for K=0.5 relative to K=0.

units.sigma_over_G: dimensionless (stress normalized by shear modulus G)

outputs.description: CSV file containing for each n the computed pileup length and applied stress for m=1 and m=2, together with the fitted Hall-Petch slopes and the ratio of slopes.

units.sigma_over_G: dimensionless (stress normalized by matrix shear modulus G1)

outputs.description: CSV file containing for each n the computed pileup length and applied stress for K=0 and K=0.5, together with the fitted Hall-Petch slopes and the ratio of slopes.

output_contract.notes: All material parameters (e.g., Poisson's ratio ν, asymptotic factors Q, critical spacing/force criteria) are specified in the problem context; the agent derives them from the force-balance equations and the specified yield criteria. The solver implementation details (root-finding method, tolerances) are left to the agent.
